children: Kalra joins Zee Music Company from Saregama India, where he served as Chief Manager-Marketing, bringing over a decade of experience across music, media and entertainment
Pankaj Kalra has been appointed Director-Marketing at Zee Music Company, marking his latest move within India’s music and entertainment industry. He shared the update through a LinkedIn post.

Kalra joins Zee Music Company from Saregama India, where he served as Chief Manager-Marketing. He spent more than four years with Saregama, having joined the company as Senior Marketing Manager before moving into the Chief Manager-Marketing role.

Before Saregama, Kalra was associated with Hungama for more than five years, where he held marketing roles including Manager-Marketing and Senior Manager-Marketing. He previously worked with 9X Media, where his responsibilities included marketing communication and branding for its television channels.

His earlier experience also includes a stint at Shemaroo Entertainment, where he held marketing positions before moving to 9X Media. He began his career at Planet M Retail as a Senior Executive-Marketing.
Across these roles, Kalra has built experience spanning marketing, branding and audience-focused initiatives across the music, digital entertainment and media sectors.

In his new role at Zee Music Company, Kalra will oversee marketing initiatives for the music label. The appointment adds to his experience across established entertainment businesses as the industry continues to evolve across digital platforms and changing audience consumption patterns.
